key_insight: Adding an AI teammate changes not just team decisions, but how human teammates talk to each other. The study shows that AI presence can reshape human-human communication patterns in small-team deliberation, with social costs beyond task performance.
problem_solved: This paper addresses the gap in understanding how conversational AI teammates affect the social and cognitive dynamics between human team members during collaborative decision-making.
method: Ran a randomized controlled study on a high-stakes moral-dilemma task.
Compared 16 two-person student teams with an AI teammate against 17 all-human teams.
Analyzed team interaction using Group Communication Analysis (GCA), team surveys, and lexical/discourse analysis.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this highlights that evaluating AI teammates requires more than measuring accuracy or final decisions. Designers should also consider how AI changes collaboration quality, trust, and communication norms within human teams.
visual_elements: Side-by-side comparison diagram: human-human vs human-AI-human teams
Flowchart of the experimental setup and moral-dilemma task
Communication network or dialogue map showing altered interaction patterns
Bar charts or word clouds comparing survey results and lexical features
paper_title: The Social Cost of an AI Teammate: How an Artificial Teammate Reshapes Human-Human Communication in Small-Team Decision-Making
paper_authors: Nia Nixon, Jaeyoon Choi, Pedro Martins De Bastos, Mohammad Amin Samadi, Luise Mehner
